features.missing: zero numerical residual plus explicit presence indicators; no fabricated starter identity, no KBO relief pitchcount, no final odds or postgame target lineup
features.evidence_gate: Every used field finite, source sha256 valid, actual observed timestamp present; max_fact_time <= decision, or max_fact_date calendar-end+24h <= decision; source dates strictly earlier and target source ID absent. observed_at after decision allowed ONLY retrospective. Strict gate requires independent pregame receipt registry, absent means0.
features.scaling: training-only mean and population std; std floor1e-8 ->1; same scaler for all leagues
features.market: single fixed offset log(p_home/p_away), p from normalized inverse of SAME case decimal odds on ALL train/validation/test. Never transfer proxy offsets. Report original saved market (Shin) and actual fixed9:1 =0.9*saved market+0.1*actual votes separately; same-price proportional market is additional control.

model.formula: p_home=sigmoid(fixed market logit + x*(beta_global + delta_league)); optimize SUM logloss +0.5*lambda_global*||beta_global||²+0.5*lambda_deviation*sum||delta_league||². Independent models use separate penalized league vectors. All coefficients including intercept shrunk toward0, never hard-thresholded.
model.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B float64 deterministic zero init, analytic gradient, maxiter2000, ftol1e-13, gtol1e-8; nonconvergence fails, no replacing candidate

selection: On validation ONLY maximize accuracy, then minimize logloss, then lexicographic candidate id. Persist every tried candidate including controls, never select on test. Baselines are not fitted trials.

inference.bootstrap: 5000 paired ISO-week cluster resamples, seed20261030; ordinary95% CIs accuracy and ROI differences vs original market AND actual fixed9:1, plus proportional market; resample shared cases, preserve paired differences.
inference.multiplicity: Exact one-sided paired sign/binomial test on discordant correctness (diagnostic independence caveat); Holm correction across all10 candidates x3leagues x2 required baselines =60, unavailable contrasts p=1. Weekly bootstrap98+ simultaneous Bonferroni family CIs: alpha=.05/60 for both accuracy and ROI, report low-tail Monte Carlo precision. Formal improvement requires selected candidate adjusted p<.05 and simultaneous accuracy lower>0 vs market and fixed9:1, minimum20 flipped test games total and10 per league; no future inference from retrospective data.
inference.no_abstention: all eligible common cases receive a pick; unsupported models fallback market, separately mark support.
